plainText:
Danny (Japanese: ダン Dan) is the Gym Leader of the Navel Island's Gym, known officially as the Navel Gym. He hands out the to Trainers who defeat him.

==History==
Danny was the second Gym Leader encountered in the Orange Islands, in Navel Maneuvers. He did not simply battle Ash, however; instead, he challenged Ash to work with his in order to win the Badge. Initially, Danny and Ash had to climb a mountain without the aid of any of their Pokémon. The next challenge was to freeze a geyser the quickest, and Danny's won over Ash's Lapras. Next, Ash and Danny each chose three Pokémon to build a bobsled from a frozen geyser jet, with Ash winning the round.
 
The final challenge was a race down the mountain and to the beach using their new bobsleds and the use of three Pokémon each. interrupted the bobsled race, trapping Ash and Danny in a pitfall trap and attempting to steal . However, Danny called out his , which sent Team Rocket blasting off and recovered Pikachu in the process. Afterwards, he and Ash continued the race, with Ash narrowly winning. With two of three of the rounds awarded to Ash, Danny presented him with the Badge.

He reappeared in flashbacks in A Way Off Day Off and Hello, Pummelo!.

==Character==
Danny enjoys the outdoors, especially activities like windsurfing and mountaineering. His charm and maturity instantly attracts girls, including , who quickly developed a crush on Danny. Danny likes to remain quiet on his position as the Gym Leader and instead prefers to observe his challenger first.
